items.headline: Jets fans boo Hellebuyck in his Winnipeg return, then beat his Devils 4-2
items.line: With Hellebuyck held out by New Jersey, the crowd chanted "Coward" in warmups and the scoreboard flashed a Devils "win probability 0.0%" after the final horn.
items.stat: Dawson Mercer 2 goals vs his old team · Devils' 5-game win streak snapped

items.headline: Vikings trade for Kirk Cousins on deadline day, bringing their old QB back
items.line: Minnesota sends a 2027 third-round pick to Las Vegas for the 38-year-old, and Fernando Mendoza takes over as the Raiders' starter. Cousins returns to replace his replacement.
items.stat: 2,340 yds, 20 TD, 8 INT with LV · Vikings offense 31st in passing

items.headline: Jeremy Fears Jr. steers No. 5 Michigan State past No. 2 Duke in the Champions Classic
items.line: The Spartans lead 34-25 at half in Chicago's United Center and hold on 79-73 as Duke shoots 33% from the field.
items.thesis: Michigan State's floor general is turning big-stage nights into a draft case.
items.stat: Fears 18 pts, 11 ast · Duke 7-of-29 from three

items.headline: Lillard and Avdija lead the Blazers past the Thunder 123-103
items.line: Tied at half, Portland rips a 14-2 third-quarter run capped by a Robert Williams III dunk and a deep Lillard three. The teams meet again Wednesday.

items.headline: Cole Hutson's first OT winner caps a Capitals comeback in Ottawa
items.line: Washington goes 21 minutes without a shot, then rallies to win 3-2. Ovechkin's assist on the winner ties Nicklas Backstrom for the franchise assists record.
items.thesis: Fastest Caps defenseman ever to 20 points, in just his 30th game.
items.stat: Fastest Caps D to 20 career points · Ovechkin ties Backstrom at 762 assists

items.headline: Tre White erupts for 30 as No. 15 Kansas routs No. 24 Kentucky
items.line: Tre White and Tyran Stokes carry the Jayhawks to an 89-69 win in the second game of the Champions Classic.

items.headline: Chiefs grab Josh Downs from the Colts minutes before the trade deadline
items.line: Kansas City sends 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks; Downs is the fourth Colt traded this fall. "I am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in Indy."
items.stat: Career-high 803 yds in 2024 · Jonathan Taylor stays in Indy

items.headline: Anthony Davis scores 44 on 16-of-21 shooting as Detroit beats Washington
items.line: Davis adds 13 rebounds in a 122-111 Pistons win; No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa answers with 21 for the Wizards.

items.headline: Knicks bury the Bucks 117-85 as Milwaukee drops to 1-10
items.line: A 32-13 second quarter breaks it open; Towns posts 21 and 16 and the Bucks lose a seventh straight.
items.stat: Bucks 1-10, 7 straight losses · Knicks win 4th in a row

items.headline: Sassuolo fire Alberto Aquilani after five straight defeats
items.line: Hired in June, the former Liverpool midfielder is out after a 3-0 loss at Roma leaves Sassuolo a point above the Serie A drop zone.
items.stat: 29 conceded in 11 games, worst in Serie A · 7 games without a win
